title: Mid-Term Endorsements on HomeShield Policies
content:
A mid-term endorsement on Homeowners Insurance changes the coverage on a policy during its term at the insured's request: the dwelling coverage (Coverage A), whether an auto policy is bundled with the agency, or whether automatic payments are set up.

## Rule applied at the desk

- **Status.** An endorsement is written only on a policy whose status is in force. The status is read from the agency's record of that same policy before the endorsement is written.
- **Re-rating.** A mid-term change re-rates the policy under the Homeowners Insurance rating rule, giving a re-rated annual term premium.
- **Pro-rata difference.** The difference between the re-rated term premium and the term premium before the change is billed, or returned, pro rata for the remaining days of the term: the difference multiplied by the remaining days of the term and divided by the days in the term. A higher re-rated premium is billed; a lower one is returned.
- **Endorsement fee.** Each insured-requested endorsement carries the program's endorsement fee.
- **Coverage A increases.** Coverage A may be raised mid-term by at most the program's mid-term increase limit percentage. A larger increase, or an increase that moves the policy out of its program's Coverage A band, requires a new quote.

## Coverage A increase decisions (hypothetical policies, 20 percent limit)

| Program band | Coverage A before | Requested Coverage A | Increase | Inside the band | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 300,000 to 449,999 | 400,000 | 440,000 | 10 percent | Yes | Endorsement |
| 300,000 to 449,999 | 300,000 | 360,000 | exactly 20 percent | Yes | Endorsement |
| 300,000 to 449,999 | 300,000 | 370,000 | more than 20 percent | Yes | New quote |
| 300,000 to 449,999 | 400,000 | 460,000 | 15 percent | No | New quote |

An increase of exactly the limit is within "at most" and may be endorsed.

## Pro-rata difference (all inputs hypothetical)

Term of 365 days, 146 days remaining at the change.

- **Billed.** Term premium before the change 1,460.00 dollars; re-rated term premium 1,825.00 dollars. Difference 365.00; 365.00 multiplied by 146 and divided by 365 is 146.00 dollars billed, together with the program's endorsement fee for the insured-requested change.
- **Returned.** Term premium before the change 1,825.00 dollars; re-rated term premium 1,642.50 dollars after a discount newly applies. Difference 182.50; 182.50 multiplied by 146 and divided by 365 is 73.00 dollars returned, and the program's endorsement fee is billed for the insured-requested change.

## Status points

A policy in status quoted, bound, cancelled or non-renewed is not in force, and no endorsement is written on it.
